changes.comment: Link a device from Settings now opens its dialog while the vault manager is on screen. It used to set the flag and show nothing until you pressed Back.

The vault manager is two columns: your vaults in a list on the left — each with its location, a linked badge, and a row menu whose Remove asks first, inline, saying exactly what removal costs — with your name at its foot; and on the right the three ways to get a vault: add one, link this device, or join a share.
